+    def rename_many(self, updates: list[dict]) -> list[Task]:
+        """Rename several tasks atomically, returning live tasks in request order.
+
+        Every entry needs exactly id and title. All validation, duplicate and
+        existence checks happen before any title is changed.
+        """
+        if not isinstance(updates, list):
+            raise ValueError("Updates must be a list of dictionaries")
+        pending = []
+        seen = set()
+        for offset, item in enumerate(updates):
+            record = validate_fields(
+                item, {"id", "title"}, name=f"Rename entry {offset}"
+            )
+            task_id = validate_id(record["id"])
+            title = validate_title(record["title"])
+            if task_id in seen:
+                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate task ID: {task_id}")
+            seen.add(task_id)
+            pending.append((task_id, title))
+        for task_id, _ in pending:
+            if task_id not in self._tasks:
+                raise KeyError(task_id)
+        result = []
+        for task_id, title in pending:
+            task = self._tasks[task_id]
+            task.title = title
+            result.append(task)
+        return result
